title: Canada Goose Reports First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results
summary: Delivered revenue of $118.9m, an increase of 10.3% on a reported basis (up 8.6% on a constant currency basis1) versus the prior year Expanded adjusted EBIT margin2 to (87.3)% from (98.7)% in the same period last year driven by gross margin expansion and SGA leverage, reducing operating loss and adjusted EBIT2 to $(103.8)m DTC comparable sales decline3 was 3.2% in the first quarter, reflecting lower store comparable sales, partially offset by double-digit e-commerce growth across all regions Maintained strong balance sheet and healthy inventory position, with inventory turns increasing 11% year-over-year to 1.0x sales Canada Goose Holdings Inc. (NYSE, TSX: GOOS) announced today financial results for the first quarter ended June 28, 2026.
